'''FK Pardubice''' is a Czech [[association football|football]] club located in the city of [[Pardubice]]. Since 2020, the club has played in the [[Czech First League]].

The club is the successor of '''TJ Tesla Pardubice''', which merged with FC Loko Pardubice in 2008.<ref>{{cite news |first=Jaroslav|last=Mach|url=http://pardubicky.denik.cz/fotbal_region/pod-vinici-nastartovan-novy-projekt-fotbalu-.html|title=Pod Vinicí nastartován nový projekt fotbalu|language=cs|work=[[Deník]]|publisher=[[Vltava Labe Media]]|date=15 January 2010|access-date=22 January 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130122184354/http://pardubicky.denik.cz/fotbal_region/pod-vinici-nastartovan-novy-projekt-fotbalu-.html|archive-date=22 January 2013}}</ref>"}}
